question: What was the primary outcome of the liberalisation and privatisation initiatives under the New Economic Policy (NEP) in 1991, followed by the Indian government?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Globalisation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary outcome of the liberalization and privatization initiatives under the New Economic Policy (NEP) in 1991 was Globalization.
 
• India's New Economic Policy (NEP) -
 
• It was signed on July 24, 1991 by the then Union Finance Minister Dr. Manmohan Singh and Prime Minister P.V. Narasimha Rao started it.
 
• The main objective of this policy was to globalize the Indian economy.
 
• So that the Indian economy can take advantage of the opportunities available in the global economy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• At present, there are only 5 sectors in the country (related to security, strategic and environmental concerns) in which the private sector will need to get a license to enter.
 
• To capitalize on the benefits of liberalization and globalization -
 
 
• The number of industries reserved for the public sector has been reduced.
 
• During the year 2014 -Private investment in rail infrastructure has also been allowed.
 
• At present, only 2 industrial areas are reserved for the public sector and all other sectors have been opened to the private sector.
 
• The areas reserved for the public sector are -
 
 
• Nuclear Energy
 
• railway operations
